summary: Researched forex market microstructure, FTMO execution quality, and slippage reduction — identified 7 gaps in NovaTrade execution pipeline with prioritized roadmap
guidance: NovaTrade has good execution guardrails (spread ceiling, rollover dead zone, news blackout, entry jitter) but lacks dynamic spread monitoring, live session filter activation, economic calendar feed, and post-news re-entry delay. Priority fixes: enable check_forex_session, extend FOMC blackout to 30min, add spread anomaly detection gate.
